diagnostics.message: `:resource.aws_cloudtrail.main` only references `aws_s3_bucket.cloudtrail` (via `s3_bucket_name = aws_s3_bucket.cloudtrail.id`), which orders it after the bucket but not after `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.cloudtrail`. CloudTrail validates S3 access when the trail is created and will fail with `InsufficientS3BucketPolicyException` unless the bucket policy granting `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` s3:GetBucketAcl / s3:PutObject is already applied (the provider's own `aws_cloudtrail` example uses `depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy.example]` for exactly this reason). Since the trail performs no attribute reference on the policy, the graph contains no edge and the two are applied concurrently.
